description: This Java class, SeoUrlUtil, provides utility methods for manipulating SEO URLs and URIs within the Ofbiz framework. It includes methods to replace special characters in URLs based on configuration and to remove the context path from a URI.

classes.name: SeoUrlUtil
classes.description: A utility class for handling SEO URL transformations, such as replacing special characters and removing context paths.

methods.name: replaceSpecialCharsUrl
methods.description: Replaces special characters in the input URL based on character filters provided by the SeoConfigUtil.

methods.name: removeContextPath
methods.description: Removes the specified context path from the given URI if it starts with it.
